title: Sampling and aliasing
subtitle: Sample a sine wave and see when the samples tell a different story.

intro.idea: A continuous signal is sampled every T = 1/fs seconds. If the signal frequency f is above fs/2 (the Nyquist frequency), the samples are identical to those of a lower frequency fa, its alias.
intro.why: Every ADC, audio system and camera must sample fast enough, or filter first, otherwise high frequencies masquerade as low ones and cannot be removed afterwards.
